title: A HARD CAP ON LOUD SOUND
why: His round 2 orders: put a hard cap on loud sounds (2.12), rain about a third quieter (2.69 b), lower only the loudest sounds a few decibels in the demo (2.12 b). The menu and stinger sounds skipped the old limiter and the music ran straight to the speakers; now everything ends in one master limiter at -2 dB. Rain is 0.030 instead of 0.045. In the demo blasts play 3 dB down and guns 2 dB down.
now: A master limiter caps every sound, the rain is a third quieter, and the demo lowers blasts and guns.
